reviews.text: There are no words to express my gratitude for what the great trainer José has shown my dog ​​Zara. She used to be fearful, disobedient, and had bad habits. With his help, she's a completely different dog, a wonderful companion. She obeys at mealtimes, walks by my side, and always comes when I call her. In other words, with his help, I have total control over my dog. And all of this training is done remotely. I'm from São Paulo, and he's from Rio de Janeiro. Thank you, José. 👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾 May God greatly bless your life.
Excellent professional, I trust him completely!! His classes have drastically improved my pinscher's behavior, and he also worked with and guided me on the socialization of my dog ​​and cats.

José managed to calm our Toquinho down and get him to respond to commands. Ragnar learned faster. It was a great suggestion from the vet.
Toquinho is doing well. He likes it when José arrives.

I had a wonderful experience with José.

I have a 7-year-old Border Collie who, to be honest, left me extremely exhausted with his behavior. To me, it seemed impossible for him to change. Walks were pure torture—both physically and emotionally—to the point that just thinking about going out with him triggered my anxiety.

That's when I decided to seek help and found José.

When he explained that he works with dog behavior, I confess I was curious—I even thought, "What's therapy for dogs like?" (laughs).

We signed up for a package of 10 lessons, but it wasn't even necessary to finish to see the change. My dog's behavior changed dramatically.

Today I can walk him calmly—without anxiety, without tension, without that anticipatory suffering.

José's work was simply impeccable. He acts respectfully, without pressure, without aggression, without raising his voice… and yet, with extremely effective results. It seems like a miracle.

José is a committed, ethical, and highly competent professional.

I am very grateful for the work he has done—and I highly recommend him.
I follow his work closely; he's a great professional, I highly recommend him!
This professional works with complete dedication, loves what they do, and your dog will be in good hands with total safety. I highly recommend them!
Excellent professional! I highly recommend him; besides his professional quality, he's a really nice guy. I will always recommend him.
José is an incredible professional; from the very first lesson, he helped us with our puppy and instructed us in the best way possible. Immensely grateful for every lesson.

We loved the training with José. We got our dog when he was still a puppy, and he was driving us crazy. José arrived, analyzed what needed to be done, and little by little, with repetition and persistence, he made our Apollo more and more balanced and respectful of us, always with a lot of patience, calmness, and kindness. I highly recommend him to everyone. When we get our next dog, I already know who I'll call!

An excellent professional and a wonderful human being. An essential quality in the work he dedicates himself to! Our dear Tae, Emi and Carla, we recognize your dedication and competence in what you do; beyond talent, there is a gift, definitive in this beautiful and loving work! Thank you so much, José! 🐾🐾 …
Thanks!
Excellent professional, you can trust him, quality service guaranteed, I'm sure you won't regret it.

José is more than just a professional dog trainer! He was a great mentor and friend in my journey with my dogs. I relied on his support during a very delicate time: I moved into a new place alone with my two dogs, who were having a lot of difficulty adapting! José analyzed the situation, understood my routine and limitations, and proposed a plan of attack that worked very well – without miraculous tricks, always respecting the animals' nature. José, congratulations on your work!
Excellent professional
